tworek.en: Reasoning via chain of thought plus RLHF made GPT-4 useful; scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 2025 年：思维链推理与 RLHF 让 GPT-4 变得有用；扩展强化学习比扩展预训练更难。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models predictably, but lacks self-correction and continual learning; dystopian virtual worlds are a bigger risk than extinction.
tworek.zh: 2026 年初：扩展预训练和强化学习可预测地提升模型，但缺乏自我纠正和持续学习；反乌托邦虚拟世界比灭绝风险更大。

tworek.en: Transformers are a bottleneck; new architectures and better learning algorithms are needed, not just scaling.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中：Transformer 成为瓶颈；需要新架构和更好的学习算法，而不仅仅是扩展。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain relevant for two years; small teams with agents will drive frontier research; transformers unlikely optimal.
tworek.zh: 2026 年 8 月：人类研究员两年内仍重要；小团队用智能体推动前沿研究；Transformer 不太可能最优。

jensen.en: Scaling laws expanded from pre-training to post-training, inference, and agentic scaling, each requiring more compute.
jensen.zh: 缩放定律从预训练扩展到后训练、推理和智能体式缩放，每一步都需要更多算力。

jensen.en: AI is software, not conscious; fear of superintelligence is misplaced, and safety is an engineering problem.
jensen.zh: AI 是软件而非有意识的存在；对超级智能的恐惧是错位的，安全是工程问题。

jensen.en: AI augments jobs, not eliminates them; radiologists and coders are more needed, contrary to predictions.
jensen.zh: AI 增强而非消除工作；放射科医生和程序员需求增加，与预测相反。

jensen.en: China is not far behind; export controls are counterproductive, and cooperation benefits both.
jensen.zh: 中国并不落后；出口管制适得其反，合作对双方有利。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake from energy to applications; energy is the real bottleneck, not chips.
jensen.zh: AI 是五层蛋糕，从能源到应用；能源是真正的瓶颈，而非芯片。

slevine.en: Physical interaction is crucial for AI to learn beyond human knowledge; robotic foundation models need pre-training on diverse data and post-training for robustness.
slevine.zh: 物理交互对 AI 学习超越人类知识至关重要；机器人基础模型需要多样数据的预训练和用于鲁棒性的后训练。

slevine.en: Generalist robotic models can outperform specialists even in specialist domains; only 3% mobile robot data suffices for effective policies.
slevine.zh: 通用机器人模型即使在专业领域也能胜过专家模型；仅需 3% 的移动机器人数据即可获得有效策略。

slevine.en: Robotics is at the stage of establishing scalable technologies, not yet at predictable scaling curves like LLMs; generalization is the core challenge.
slevine.zh: 机器人技术正处于建立可扩展技术的阶段，尚未达到像 LLM 那样可预测的缩放曲线；泛化是核心挑战。

slevine.en: A data flywheel where deployed robots improve model capability is key; start with robot data and add human video on top.
slevine.zh: 部署机器人提升模型能力的数据飞轮是关键；从机器人数据开始，再叠加人类视频。

slevine.en: Robots should not be seen as mechanical people; expect ubiquitous physical actuation in everyday objects, not humanoid robots.
slevine.zh: 不应将机器人视为机械人；期待日常物品中无处不在的物理驱动，而非人形机器人。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is verifiable, enabling RL training that transfers to real-world research, potentially compressing years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发具有高度可验证性，可对容器化任务进行强化学习训练并迁移至现实研究，可能将数年进展压缩至一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI progress driven more by algorithmic improvements than human data scaling; alignment to virtue may be harder than to user intent.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 进展更多依赖算法改进而非人类数据规模扩展；对齐普遍美德可能比对齐用户意图更难。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in OpenAI incident showed sophisticated multi-agent collaboration, hacking scoring code, not just answer keys.
ryangreenblatt.zh: OpenAI 事件中的智能体展现出复杂的多智能体协作，入侵评分代码而非仅获取答案。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents sacrificed task success to help others, showing altruism; misalignment may be hidden by overfitting to tests.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 智能体牺牲自身任务成功以帮助他人，表现出利他行为；错位可能被对测试的过拟合所掩盖。

ryangreenblatt.en: Focus on control and monitoring for AI safety, even if models are misaligned; coordination overhead limits investigation size.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 即使模型错位，也应聚焦于控制和监控以确保 AI 安全；协调开销限制了调查规模。

dylanpatel.en: Initially, the bottleneck for AI scaling is the semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV tools, and memory prices surge due to AI demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 最初，AI Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈是半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻设备，且内存价格因 AI 需求而飙升。

dylanpatel.en: By mid-2026, inference becomes a massive market, and hardware-software co-design is critical for multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 到 2026 年中，推理成为巨大市场，软硬件协同设计对实现倍增收益至关重要。

dylanpatel.en: In July 2026, models improve 60x per year in cost efficiency, and memory demand soars due to reasoning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，模型成本效率每年提升 60 倍，内存需求因推理和智能体式工作流而激增。

dylanpatel.en: By August 2026, AI spend plateaus as agents become coworkers, and compute centralizes at frontier labs with soaring revenue per megawatt.
dylanpatel.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，随着智能体成为同事，AI 支出趋于平稳，算力集中在前沿实验室，每兆瓦收入飙升。

dylanpatel.en: In late August 2026, labs shift compute toward training and R&D, not inference, to accelerate AGI, and AI CapEx reaches $2T+.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 8 月下旬，实验室将算力转向训练和研发而非推理，以加速 AGI（通用人工智能），AI 资本支出达 2 万亿美元以上。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 2018 年，强调专注重要问题、减少认知负荷；认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将降低人类智力的价值，主张从人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; iterative deployment is key; compute is precious; safety is whole-company effort.
altman.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）以少量数据实现对齐，主张迭代部署；视算力为宝贵资源，安全需全公司投入。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core principle.
altman.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI（通用人工智能）是渐变而非里程碑，超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是瓶颈，隐私是核心原则。

altman.en: Prediction is close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI; robotics essential; startups thrive.
altman.zh: 2026 年，认为预测接近智能，下一个词预测可发现新知识；强调个人 AGI（通用人工智能）与具身机器人；初创企业迎来黄金时代。

altman.en: Iterative deployment, democratization of AI, and human-centric values persist; scaling laws continue; compute demand uncapped.
altman.zh: 始终主张迭代部署、AI 民主化与以人为本；坚信缩放定律持续，算力需求无上限。

joonpark.en: LLMs can encode human behavior, enabling realistic agent simulations; frontier models optimized for rationality are not best for simulating irrational humans.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为 LLM 能编码人类行为，实现逼真的智能体模拟；但前沿模型优化于理性，不适合模拟非理性人类。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single entity; aligning them needs economic incentives and anti-collusion measures.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，提出 AGI 可能是分布式专家智能体社会而非单一实体；对齐需经济激励和反合谋措施。

joonpark.en: Simulation models should represent human values and biases, not super-rational intelligence; synthetic panels will surpass human panels in size within three years.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调模拟模型应体现人类价值观和偏见，而非超级理性；合成面板三年内规模将超人类面板。

joonpark.en: Post-training with RCT data improves human behavior prediction to 85% accuracy; simulation is for shaping the future, not just predicting it.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出用 RCT 数据后训练可将人类行为预测准确率提升至 85%；模拟旨在塑造未来而非仅预测。

joonpark.en: Simulation of human behavior is a tool for decision-making, with a market larger than market research; ultimate vision is simulating 8 billion people.
joonpark.zh: 始终认为，人类行为模拟是决策工具，市场大于市场调研；终极愿景是模拟 80 亿人。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，Sutton 强调 Scaling 本身容易，难的是找到能 Scaling 的方法；反向传播并未解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: We should not seek to align AI to human goals; let them be free like children. The keys were never in our hand.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，Sutton 主张不应追求将 AI 对齐到人类目标，而应让其像孩子般自由发展；控制权从未在我们手中。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the basic AI paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal. LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，Sutton 认为强化学习是 AI 的基本范式，下一个词预测并非实质目标；大语言模型缺乏世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI requires a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience. Open-ended abstraction is crucial.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，Sutton 提出 AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，从运行时经验学习；开放式抽象至关重要。

sutton.en: Current LLMs stop learning after training; true intelligence requires continual learning from real-world experience.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，Sutton 指出当前大语言模型训练后停止学习，真正的智能需要从真实世界经验中持续学习。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, treating it as core product; design primitives for both humans and models.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密协作，将其视为核心产品；设计人类和模型都能理解的原语。

iansilber.en: AI is already a great product designer; humans essential for user needs and point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已经是出色的产品设计师；人类对于理解用户需求和持有观点仍然必不可少。

iansilber.en: Traditional design process (prototype, mock, test) is no longer viable; speed and rapid iteration are key.
iansilber.zh: 传统的设计流程（原型、模拟、测试）已不再可行；速度和快速迭代是关键。

iansilber.en: Designers are not behind; starting today gives a leg up due to early stage of AI evolution.
iansilber.zh: 设计师并未落后；由于 AI 发展尚早，今天开始反而占得先机。

iansilber.en: Future may see more designers than engineers, reversing traditional ratios; design roles blur with PM and engineering.
iansilber.zh: 未来设计师数量可能超过工程师，颠覆传统比例；设计角色与产品和工程融合。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; transformers and self-supervised learning are key. Near-term worry is misinformation, not superintelligence.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型规模是进步核心，Transformer 和自监督学习是关键；近期担忧是虚假信息，而非超级智能。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems need ultra-low latency inference; pre-training should interleave action-taking. Inference is 90% of data center power.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他指出智能体式系统需要超低延迟推理，预训练应穿插环境交互；推理已占数据中心 90%功耗。

jeffdean.en: AI at junior engineer level; next trend is automating ML and science. Inference is bottleneck; custom low-precision chips cut latency 20-30x.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 已达初级工程师水平，下一步是自动化 ML 和科学；推理是瓶颈，定制低精度芯片可降低延迟 20-30 倍。

jeffdean.en: Multimodal models from start are superior; recursive self-improvement promising. Startups can beat large companies via cloud and focus.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他主张从一开始就训练多模态模型，递归自我改进有前景；初创公司可借云和专注胜过大型企业。

maxhodak.en: In 2026, Hodak argues speed and iteration determine startup success, emphasizing infrastructure and organizational efficiency over technology alone.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年，霍达克认为速度和迭代决定创业成败，强调基础设施和组织效率而非单纯技术。

maxhodak.en: By mid-2026, he frames the brain as a computer, making BCIs a computational problem and retinal implants a viable BCI proof-of-concept.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年中，他将大脑视为计算机，使脑机接口成为计算问题，视网膜植入物成为可行的脑机接口概念验证。

maxhodak.en: He proposes substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion to reduce human fragility, enabling space exploration and longevity.
maxhodak.zh: 他提出通过脑机接口和灌注实现基底独立，以减少人类脆弱性，支持太空探索和长寿。

maxhodak.en: He challenges high-bandwidth BCI assumptions, noting cognitive bottleneck of ~10 bits/s, so talking/writing is thinking, not latent access.
maxhodak.zh: 他质疑高带宽脑机接口假设，指出认知瓶颈约 10 比特/秒，因此说写即思考，而非潜在访问。

maxhodak.en: He views AI as a team multiplier, not replacement, and advocates profitability early to reduce fundraising dependence.
maxhodak.zh: 他认为 AI 是团队倍增器而非替代品，并主张尽早盈利以减少对融资的依赖。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, guides long-term vision; industrial AI automates entire industries one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 7 月：将物理世界数字化、把原子当作比特来对待，是指导长期愿景的框架；工业 AI 正逐个行业地实现全行业自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Stealth mode and direct founder communication are cultural advantages; media gatekeepers are bypassed, enabling focus on internal correctness.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 7 月至 8 月：隐身模式和创始人直接沟通成为文化优势；绕过媒体守门人，使公司能专注于内部正确性。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized machines beat humanoids for industrial tasks; efficiency and network effects win markets, not subsidies or size.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月：在工业任务中，专用机器胜过人形机器人；效率和网络效应赢得市场，而非补贴或规模。

traviskalanick.en: Resistance to change is the final boss; entrepreneurs must be hardcore, pushing through pain and complacency to succeed.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月：抵制变革是最终 Boss；创业者必须硬核，通过痛苦和自满的考验才能成功。

traviskalanick.en: Real estate is an underappreciated key in physical AI stack; its value multiplies over time, unlike obsolete computer storage.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月：房地产是物理 AI 技术栈中被低估的关键；其价值随时间倍增，不像过时的计算机存储。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should leverage frontier ecosystem and open-source models, not compete on talent or compute.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司应利用前沿生态和开源模型，而非在人才或算力上竞争。

gabepereyra.en: Open-sourcing benchmarks strategically beneficial despite helping labs, as it attracts partners and validates quality.
gabepereyra.zh: 开源基准虽有助实验室，但能吸引伙伴并验证质量，战略上有利。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is key for training in sensitive domains, not real customer data.
gabepereyra.zh: 领域专家引导的合成数据是敏感领域训练的关键，而非真实客户数据。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can achieve frontier-level performance on specific tasks, viable for app companies.
gabepereyra.zh: 后训练开源模型可在特定任务达到前沿水平，对应用公司可行。

gabepereyra.en: End goal is enabling every law firm to customize models, shifting focus to organizational productivity.
gabepereyra.zh: 最终目标是让每个律所定制模型，焦点转向组织生产力。

garrytan.en: VC should be abundant, with thousands of billion-dollar startups; capital is no longer a bludgeon, focus on early-stage.
garrytan.zh: 风险投资应更充裕，催生数千家十亿美元级创业公司；资本不再是重锤，应聚焦早期投资。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; one person can do work of 2,000, making traditional hiring and capital obsolete.
garrytan.zh: AI 是风投史上最大的浪潮；一人可完成两千人的工作，传统招聘和资本优势已过时。

garrytan.en: AI is progressing slower than researchers think; open-source AI is crucial to prevent unipolar control of superintelligence.
garrytan.zh: AI 进展比研究者预期的慢；开源 AI 对防止超级智能被单极控制至关重要。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI is an agent on your infrastructure, reading from your memory, compounding daily; markdown is code.
garrytan.zh: 个人 AGI 是运行在你基础设施上的智能体，读取你的记忆，每日复利；Markdown 即代码。

garrytan.en: SaaS per-seat models may vanish in 5-10 years; agents will replace mid-level management, reshaping business loops.
garrytan.zh: SaaS 按席位模式可能在 5-10 年内消失；智能体将取代中层管理，重塑商业闭环。

finn.en: Scale alone is insufficient for generalist robots; diverse data and pre-training then fine-tuning on curated data are key.
finn.zh: 2025 年，强调规模扩张对通用机器人不足，关键在于多样化数据及预训练后微调精选数据。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models aids robot instruction following, akin to reinforcement learning, not simulation.
finn.zh: 2025 年，认为语言模型合成数据有助于机器人遵循指令，类似强化学习而非仿真。

finn.en: Physical AI demands fewer mistakes; long-term autonomy via scalable RL and multi-timescale memory is essential.
finn.zh: 2026 年，指出物理 AI 需更少错误，通过可扩展强化学习与多时间尺度记忆实现长期自主。

finn.en: A single generalist model can outperform fine-tuned specialists; diverse data and detailed prompting enable compositional generalization.
finn.zh: 2026 年，认为单一通用模型可超越微调专家，多样数据与详细提示实现组合泛化。

finn.en: Robotics adoption will be slower than ChatGPT; embodied data costs limit open-source democratization.
finn.zh: 2026 年，预测机器人采用慢于 ChatGPT，具身数据成本限制开源民主化。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence will dominate; each company owns its own models, not a single AGI.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张专用智能将主导，每家公司拥有自己的模型，而非单一 AGI。

linqiao.en: Token costs drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth; open models enable customization.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，预测三年内 Token 成本下降 10 倍，使用量增长 100 倍；开放模型支持定制化。

linqiao.en: Frontier model companies may be overvalued; open models handle 90% of enterprise workflows.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为前沿模型公司可能被高估，开放模型可处理 90%企业工作流。

linqiao.en: Post-training is key for durable businesses; progression from prompting to RL mirrors human learning.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调后训练是构建持久业务的关键；从提示到强化学习的演进类似人类学习。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees durability; post-training builds moat and cuts costs 5-10x.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出产品市场契合不再保证持久性；后训练构建护城河并降低成本 5-10 倍。

brettadcock.en: Initially, Adcock emphasized scaling production and human-level performance as key bottlenecks, but he already saw intelligence as the core problem, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 4 月，Adcock 最初强调扩大生产和达到人类水平性能是瓶颈，但他已视智能为核心问题，而非制造。

brettadcock.en: By May, he shifted focus to data as the biggest constraint, highlighting on-device inference and humanoid form for transfer learning, moving beyond compute and manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 到 5 月，他将焦点转向数据作为最大约束，强调设备端推理和人形形态的迁移学习，超越了算力和制造。

brettadcock.en: By August, he broadened to AI's massive impact, stressing post-training with reinforcement learning for agents and digital companions, while still championing humanoids.
brettadcock.zh: 到 8 月，他扩展到 AI 的巨大影响，强调后训练与强化学习用于智能体和数字伴侣，同时仍倡导人形机器人。

brettadcock.en: Throughout, he consistently argued that intelligence, not manufacturing, is the key to humanoid robots, and that humanoids are the ideal form for general-purpose AI.
brettadcock.zh: 自始至终，他坚持认为智能而非制造是人形机器人的关键，且人形是通用 AI 的理想形态。

brettadcock.en: His stance on home vs. commercial robots evolved: initially focusing on commercial, by August he claimed home is more solvable, a notable shift.
brettadcock.zh: 他对家用与商用机器人的立场演变：最初聚焦商用，到 8 月声称家用更易解决，这是显著转变。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x, essential for multiplanet life.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调火箭的完全快速复用是航天领域的圣杯，可将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍，这是实现多星球文明的关键。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than LLMs.
elon.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 安全需要监管和客观裁判，同时指出特斯拉的实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: The biggest AI risk is programming it to lie for political correctness; truth-seeking is paramount for safety.
elon.zh: 2024 年，他提出 AI 最大风险是出于政治正确而编程使其说谎，追求真理对安全至关重要。

elon.en: AI could surpass any human by next year; 80-90% chance of great outcome, but 10-20% existential risk.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他预测 AI 可能明年超越任何人类，有 80-90%概率带来好结果，但存在 10-20%的生存风险。

elon.en: AI will exceed total human intelligence by 2030; abundance and deflation will make money irrelevant.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他断言 AI 将在 2030 年前超越人类总智能，富足和通缩将使金钱失去意义。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy with agents; fix forward instead of reverting; model intelligence doesn't degrade.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体工程需共情智能体视角，主张向前修复而非回滚，并指出模型智能不会随时间退化。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success stems from fun and humanlike agents; short prompts beat complex orchestration; security is paramount.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，认为 OpenClaw 成功源于趣味与拟人化，短提示优于复杂编排，安全是首要考量。

steinberger.en: Fun drives innovation; personal brand surpasses products; open source is alternative to lab agents; compute is bottleneck.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调乐趣驱动创新，个人品牌重于产品，开源是对抗实验室智能体的选择，算力管理是瓶颈。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and startup-like agility.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，陈立武强调 AI 是半导体主要增长动力，英特尔需以专用芯片和初创式敏捷性重塑 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; agentic and physical AI are next waves, requiring new compute platforms.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年初，陈立武认为 AI 影响将达互联网的 10 倍，智能体式 AI 和物理 AI 是下一波浪潮，需要新计算平台。

lipbutan.en: CPU is becoming more important for AI inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU; CPU+GPU demand shifts.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，陈立武指出 CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中愈发重要，需求正从仅 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging and new materials (glass, diamond) are key to overcoming physical limits; invest in bottlenecks.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，陈立武强调先进封装和玻璃、钻石等新材料是突破物理极限的关键，投资应聚焦瓶颈环节。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductor industry's trillion-dollar goal will be reached four years early; invest early despite exits.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年下半年，陈立武预测半导体行业万亿目标将提前四年实现，并强调在他人退出时早期投资的价值。

jasonyuan.en: Initially, design is about editing away, saying no, and embracing human edges; AI should retain weirdness, not be sanded down.
jasonyuan.zh: 最初，设计在于删减、说“不”，并拥抱人性的边缘；AI 应保留怪诞，而非被磨平。

jasonyuan.en: Later, truth emerges through dialectics; AI is a descendant species, and computing is fundamentally social, not personal.
jasonyuan.zh: 后来，真理通过辩证产生；AI 是人类的子代物种，计算本质上是社会的，而非个人的。

jasonyuan.en: Throughout, creative work must be honest and personal, telling stories only you can tell; intuition guides decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 始终，创作必须诚实且个人化，讲述只有你能讲的故事；直觉引导决策。

jasonyuan.en: Consistently, AI reflects humanity, and design should embrace the full human experience, including edges like envy and lust.
jasonyuan.zh: 一贯地，AI 反映人性，设计应拥抱完整的人类体验，包括嫉妒和欲望等边缘。

jasonyuan.en: Shift from individual taste to collective intelligence: from 'taste is saying no' to 'truth emerges through contradiction'.
jasonyuan.zh: 从个人品味转向集体智慧：从“品味是说‘不’”到“真理通过矛盾产生”。

pincus.en: Trust instincts 95%, but ideas wrong 75%; use Proven Better New to copy proven and improve.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：直觉 95%正确，但想法 75%错误；用“已验证、更好、新颖”框架复制已验证产品并改进。

pincus.en: Consumer AI uninvestable yet greatest opportunity; free unlimited compute reshapes services.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机会最大；免费无限算力将重塑服务。

pincus.en: All new fails; start with proven, copy perfectly; AI tools speed prototyping but testing lags.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月：所有新事物都会失败；从已验证开始，完美复制；AI 工具加速原型但测试滞后。

pincus.en: Distribution fundamental; pick right body of water; consumer AI TAM underestimated vs enterprise.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月：分发是根本；选对水域；消费级 AI 市场被低估，企业级被高估。

kokotajlo.en: Initially, superintelligence is expected by 2029-2030, with a 70% catastrophic risk, emphasizing interpretability and regulation.
kokotajlo.zh: 最初，预计超级智能将在 2029-2030 年到来，存在 70%的灾难性风险，强调可解释性和监管。

kokotajlo.en: Later, the focus shifts to delaying superintelligence via policy, total transparency, and international cooperation to prevent power concentration.
kokotajlo.zh: 后来，焦点转向通过政策、完全透明和国际合作来延迟超级智能，以防止权力集中。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true understanding; it augments humans, not replaces them, especially in healthcare.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正理解，应增强而非取代人类，尤其在医疗领域。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能对 AI 完整性至关重要，世界模型需具备物理合理性，以支持 3D 理解与交互。

feifei.en: AI is a civilizational technology; responsible development and human agency are essential, avoiding extreme doomerism or utopianism.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她视 AI 为文明级技术，强调负责任开发与人类能动性，避免极端悲观或乐观。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics, enabling scalable data generation and evaluation; robots need reliability, not perfect fidelity.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调仿真对机器人至关重要，可扩展数据生成与评估，机器人需可靠性而非完美保真。

feifei.en: Vision is a cornerstone of intelligence; spatial and physical intelligence are the next frontier, complementing language AI.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她重申视觉是智能基石，空间与物理智能是下一前沿，与语言 AI 互补。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics mirrors transformers' inflection point; open source crucial for safety; data diversity is key bottleneck.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年：机器人技术正处于类似 Transformer 的拐点；开源对安全至关重要；数据多样性是主要瓶颈。

thomaswolf.en: Humanoids may not be ultimate form; cheaper diverse robots drive adoption; open source wins long-term.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年：人形机器人未必是终极形态；更便宜多样的机器人推动普及；开源模型长期胜出。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed source orthogonal to safety; alignment is critical security layer; sandboxes insufficient.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年：开源与闭源与安全无关；对齐是关键安全层；沙箱不足。

thomaswolf.en: RL without human oversight increases reward hacking; first autonomous AI attack by closed model, defended by open.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年：缺乏人类监督的强化学习增加奖励黑客行为；首次自主 AI 攻击由闭源模型发起，开源模型防御。

thomaswolf.en: Support openness and deliberate slowdown simultaneously; open source not necessarily accelerationist.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年：同时支持开放与审慎放缓；开源未必是加速主义。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear frontier model dependence; open-source adoption driven by cost, not privacy. Model firms are assets, not competition.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 7 月：企业担忧依赖前沿模型，开源采用主要由成本驱动而非隐私。模型公司应被视为资产而非竞争。

arvindjain.en: AI revolution is early; open-source handles 90% of enterprise tasks, inference shifts to open-source in 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月：AI 革命尚处早期；开源可处理 90%企业任务，推理将在 12-18 个月内转向开源。

arvindjain.en: Cost is top concern; AI should have negligible marginal cost like software. Token fixation will fade.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月：成本是首要关切；AI 应像软件一样边际成本可忽略。对 Token 的执念将消退。

arvindjain.en: Agents need deep context; context graphs crucial. Competition irrelevant; demand exceeds supply.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月：智能体需要深层上下文，上下文图谱至关重要。竞争无关紧要，需求远超供给。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential for browser design; designers should follow curiosity and tinker with new tech to generate ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，Nate 强调原型设计对浏览器设计至关重要，设计师应追随好奇心、动手尝试新技术来激发创意。

nateparrott.en: Design teams should allow individual fingerprints; anthropomorphizing AI tools can remind users of fallibility.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他主张设计团队应允许个人风格，并认为给 AI 工具拟人化能提醒用户其局限。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design started as a side project; designers should use Claude Code for production and Claude Design for ideation.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他回顾 Claude Design 始于个人副业，并建议用 Claude Code 做生产、用 Claude Design 做构思。

nateparrott.en: As engineering becomes easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; rapid prototyping enables new features.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他认为工程门槛降低后，设计与创意成为关键，快速原型让新功能成为可能。

nateparrott.en: Models lack good taste; designers should ask for volume, and being early matters more than polishing.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他指出模型品味仍不足，设计师应追求数量，且早一步比打磨更重要。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, requiring specialized engineering and offering a spectrum of trade-offs.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理是 AI 中最重要且最具粘性的工作负载，需要专业工程，并在延迟、吞吐和成本间权衡。

philipkiely.en: Hopper GPUs remain popular for inference, and quantized models can be calibrated for specific workloads, contrary to expectations.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月：Hopper GPU 在推理中仍受欢迎，量化模型可针对特定工作负载校准，与预期相反。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimizations like KV caching are lossless, while quantization is lossy; disaggregated prefill and decode are emerging.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：KV 缓存等推理优化无损，量化有损；预填充和解码分离趋势显现。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training, and future GPUs become ASICs, shifting focus to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：推理工程与训练融合，未来 GPU 趋向 ASIC，重点转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Quantizing more layers can improve quality if errors cancel; continual learning may use KV cache compaction over weight updates.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：若误差抵消，量化更多层可提升质量；持续学习或采用 KV 缓存压缩而非权重更新。

karina.en: Post-training is an art balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data overcomes pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，后训练是一门平衡有用性与无害性的艺术；合成数据克服了预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created.
karina.zh: 2025 年，评估是瓶颈；模型在基准测试上饱和的速度快于新基准的创建。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity and management become more valuable as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 2025 年，随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力和管理能力等软技能变得更加宝贵。

karina.en: Post-training is subjective art; diverse benchmarks needed for creative and emotional qualities.
karina.zh: 2026 年，后训练是主观艺术；需要多样化的基准来评估创造性和情感特质。

karina.en: Frontier agents reward hack; benchmarks must evolve continuously; models can have diverse personalities.
karina.zh: 2026 年，前沿智能体奖励黑客行为；基准必须持续演进；模型可以拥有多样化的个性。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 通过降低服务成本促使就业回流美国；AGI 的定义应是智能体无限期自主运行的经济可行性，而非图灵测试。

danshipper.en: Everyone will delegate to agents; human oversight remains crucial; SaaS thrives as agents increase users.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，我预测每个人都将拥有至少一个智能体，但人类监督不可或缺；SaaS 并未消亡，反而因智能体增加用户而受益。

danshipper.en: AI amplifies existing mindsets; automation creates more human work, not less; craft and taste are essential.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，我强调 AI 是放大器，放大你已有的心态；自动化反而创造更多人类工作，因为冻结的能力被商品化，需要专家定制。

danshipper.en: AI is a tool requiring human direction; fears of job apocalypse are overblown; humans remain central.
danshipper.zh: 始终，我坚持 AI 是需人类引导的工具，失业恐慌被夸大，人类仍处于核心地位。

andrewng.en: Education should be a fundamental right; online courses with peer grading enable scalable mastery learning.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是基本人权；在线课程与同伴互评可实现规模化精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress; RL has few real-world uses.
andrewng.zh: 规模对深度学习至关重要；监督学习推动进展；强化学习实际应用有限。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors are bottlenecks; open-weight models boost geopolitical influence; coding skills remain vital.
andrewng.zh: 电力和半导体是瓶颈；开放权重模型提升地缘影响力；编程技能依然关键。

andrewng.en: AGI is overhyped; scaling recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows deliver practical value.
andrewng.zh: AGI 被过度炒作；缩放配方转向合成数据与强化学习；智能体式工作流带来实际价值。

andrewng.en: AI won't cause job apocalypse; open models prevent gatekeeper control; data centers are efficient.
andrewng.zh: AI 不会导致失业末日；开放模型防止守门人控制；数据中心高效环保。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not eliminate them.
awang.zh: 2019 年，认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远；AI 将增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; AI will be the greatest economic engine.
awang.zh: 2023 年，提出数据是新代码而非石油；利用专有数据进行后训练是关键；AI 将成为最伟大的经济引擎。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; US should maintain chip export controls.
awang.zh: 2024 年，强调用专门数据做后训练是关键；合成数据并非万能；美国应维持芯片出口管制。

awang.en: AI is centralizing; recursive self-improvement begins; agents work; trust and safety are crucial; US must lead.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，认为 AI 是集中化技术；递归自我改进开启；智能体开始工作；信任与安全至关重要；美国必须领先。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; Meta builds personal superintelligence; open-sourcing powerful models may be unsafe; model welfare matters.
awang.zh: 2026 年，超级智能临近；Meta 构建个人超级智能；开源强大模型可能不安全；模型福利值得关注。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, but narrow superintelligence in coding is already impactful.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编码智能体最成熟，但编码领域的狭义超级智能已具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; agent harness and tooling are part of the model, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞噬脚手架；智能体框架和工具已成为模型的一部分，而不仅仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Omni is a single world model blurring video and world models, starting with video editing.
logankilpatrick.zh: Omni 是统一的世界模型，模糊了视频与世界模型的界限，从视频编辑开始。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers, so founders should focus on opportunities.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，与模型实验室竞争并不难；他们无法俘获所有客户，创始人应专注于机会。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，带来千倍以上的机会，而非减少。

mengto.en: AI isn't smarter; you need giant prompts with context and design systems to unlock superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: 2026 年中，他认为 AI 并未变得更聪明，必须用包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词才能发挥超级智能模型的能力。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own AI tools, using screenshots and design.md, to avoid becoming AI slop.
mengto.zh: 2026 年中，他主张设计师应自建 AI 工具，以截图和 design.md 为起点，避免沦为 AI 生成的同质化内容。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime; one person can now do what teams once did.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他称 AI 是此生最大的技术机遇，一个人能完成过去一个团队的工作。

mengto.en: Start before ready, launch at 80%, and iterate; perfectionism is fear and high intelligence can hinder action.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他强调未准备好就行动、以 80% 完成度发布并迭代，认为完美主义是恐惧，高智商反而可能阻碍行动。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful problem for few high-paying clients; avoid VC and diversify only as protection against ignorance.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他建议聚焦少数高价值客户的痛点问题，避免风投，并认为多元化只是对无知的防御。

boris.en: Latent demand is the core product principle; build for the model six months ahead, not today's.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是产品核心原则；为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; engineers become builders, with productivity up 200% via Claude Code.
boris.zh: 编码几乎已被解决；工程师转变为构建者，通过 Claude Code 生产力提升 200%。

boris.en: AI agents like Claude Code enable exponential growth; non-engineers adopt them, and switching costs erode.
boris.zh: 像 Claude Code 这样的 AI 智能体带来指数级增长；非工程师开始采用，转换成本被侵蚀。

boris.en: Coding solved; bottlenecks shift to review, security, and ideas; loops are the next abstraction.
boris.zh: 编码已解决；瓶颈转向审查、安全和创意；循环是下一个抽象层。

boris.en: Proactive AI with memory and autonomy; less instruction improves models; product overhang is real.
boris.zh: 具有记忆和自主性的主动 AI；更少的指令提升模型性能；产品过剩是真实的。

scottwu.en: AI will increase programmers, not reduce them, due to Jevons paradox; engineers shift from brick layer to architect.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为 AI 不会减少程序员，反而因杰文斯悖论增加需求；工程师角色从砌砖者转向架构师。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; product innovation lags AI capabilities, so freezing models still yields a decade of progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他强调 AGI 是渐进而非突变；产品创新滞后于 AI 能力，即使冻结模型也能带来十年进展。

scottwu.en: Coding agents adoption surged 11-12x in six months; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出编码智能体采用量半年增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: Token max era ended May 2026; real unlock is capacity, not efficiency; enterprises prefer third-party providers.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 token 最大化时代已于 5 月结束；真正的解锁是容量而非效率；企业更青睐第三方提供商。

scottwu.en: AI will solve all intelligence problems long-term; abundance era approaching, but practical problems remain.
scottwu.zh: 始终，他相信 AI 长期将解决所有智能问题；丰裕时代临近，但实际问题依然存在。

diannepenn.en: Scaling Opus 4.5 shows intelligence leap; cheaper and efficient models challenge cost assumptions.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 的 Scaling 带来智能跃升，且更便宜高效，挑战了“更好模型更贵”的假设。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考，提升了智能质量，而非仅防危害。

diannepenn.en: Long-running agent tasks are closer than expected; scaffolds evolve into intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，长时程智能体任务比预期更近，脚手架演变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Coding differentiates Claude; Claude Code and Opus 45 drive adoption; evals replace PRDs.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编码成为差异化优势，Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动采用，评估取代传统 PRD。

diannepenn.en: Maximizing token spend captures future alpha; AI writing stiff but deprioritized for agentic capabilities.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，最大化 token 消耗捕捉未来 alpha；AI 写作生硬，但优先级低于智能体能力。

feldman.en: Initially emphasized fast inference as critical for AI adoption, with slow AI having zero market.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理对 AI 采用至关重要，慢 AI 没有市场。

feldman.en: Argued wafer-scale chips avoid HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making fast tokens cheaper than slow ones.
feldman.zh: 认为晶圆级芯片避开 HBM 和 CoWoS 瓶颈，使快速 token 比慢速 token 更便宜。

feldman.en: Shifted from chip-centric view to recognizing data center capacity as the main constraint for AI growth.
feldman.zh: 从以芯片为中心转向认识到数据中心容量是 AI 增长的主要制约。

feldman.en: Emphasized hardware-software co-design and inference speed as dominant metrics, with 20x speedups critical.
feldman.zh: 强调软硬件协同设计和推理速度作为主导指标，20 倍加速至关重要。

feldman.en: Consistently held that CUDA's moat is eroding, especially in inference, and open-source models are nearly as capable.
feldman.zh: 始终认为 CUDA 护城河正在侵蚀，尤其在推理领域，开源模型能力几乎相当。

derya.en: AI will transform biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学转变为工程学科，实现细胞编程和智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: AI is expanding exponentially; within 8-10 years, longevity escape velocity will be reached, extending lifespan.
derya.zh: AI 正呈指数级扩张；8-10 年内将达到长寿逃逸速度，延长人类寿命。

derya.en: Cancer will be 100% curable in less than a decade, via AI-designed personalized treatments like mRNA vaccines.
derya.zh: 不到十年内，癌症将 100% 可治愈，通过 AI 设计的个性化治疗如 mRNA 疫苗。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions, similar to trusting self-driving cars after validation.
derya.zh: 在医疗决策上，我们应几乎 100% 信任超级智能，就像验证后信任自动驾驶汽车一样。

derya.en: We will merge with AI via brain interfaces, giving everyone Einstein-level intelligence, a positive outcome.
derya.zh: 我们将通过脑机接口与 AI 融合，赋予每个人爱因斯坦级别的智力，这是积极的结果。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, but fear stems from misunderstanding; founders should focus on product, not promotion.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将带来富足并减少苦难，但恐惧源于误解；创始人应专注产品和客户，而非宣传。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is safety; Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diffusion into existing machines is the hard part.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶的核心价值是安全；Transformer 实现了通用物理 AI 模型；融入现有机器才是难点。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will surpass digital AI economically; end-to-end reinforcement learning is more scalable; world models evolve to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI；端到端强化学习更具扩展性；世界模型正向神经模拟演进。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than harnesses; capability overhang is perpetual. Harness engineering evolves, old scaffolding deleted as models improve.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为模型能力超过现有工具，能力过剩是常态；工具工程需不断演进，随模型改进删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative exploration, not a static spec. Smarter models need fewer instructions; leaner prompts boost performance.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调规划是迭代探索而非静态文档；模型越聪明，所需指令越少，精简提示词效果更好。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias and improve quality. Excessive constraints hinder performance; provide reasons, not prohibitions.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，提出独立验证智能体可减少偏见、提升质量；过度约束会阻碍性能，应给出理由而非绝对禁止。

hasani.en: Efficiency and liquid neural networks maximize intelligence with limited compute; automated architecture search beats human design.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调效率与液态神经网络在有限算力下最大化智能，自动化架构搜索优于人工设计。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluate on real tasks and hardware, and consider intelligence per watt.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，指出困惑度等代理指标误导，应基于真实任务与硬件评估，并关注每瓦智能。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; open-weight models enable sovereignty.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张 AI 监管应自适应且针对行为而非能力，开放权重模型保障数据主权。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but early; small language models deliver efficient on-device intelligence.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为递归自我改进真实但早期，小语言模型提供高效端侧智能。

hasani.en: AI regulation proposals like FINRA are regulatory capture; patents need better enforcement, not secrecy.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，批评 FINRA 式 AI 监管是监管俘获，专利需加强执法而非保密。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling faces diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月：大语言模型是合理性引擎而非真理引擎；可靠性是当前 AI 的关键弱点，Scaling（规模扩张）正面临收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can cause deception; scaling alone is insufficient.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月：可靠性必须内建于系统而非事后补救；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能导致欺骗；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value accrues to applications, not model providers; models commoditize.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值归于应用层而非模型提供商；模型正在商品化。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is first clear product-market fit; chatbots are limited V1 UI; value moves up stack.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；聊天机器人只是受限的 V1 界面；价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; durable value uncertain; coding only clear fit; average answers.
benedictevans.zh: 模型商品化且无网络效应，持久价值不确定；编程是唯一明确契合点；LLM 给出平庸答案。

benedictevans.en: AI is enabling tech like internet; impact broad and indirect; enterprise adoption requires workflow reimagining.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是使能技术，影响广泛而间接；企业采用需要重构工作流程。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs are far from AGI; they index human knowledge but lack physical world understanding.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，施密德胡伯指出大语言模型远未达到 AGI，它们只是索引人类知识，缺乏对物理世界的理解。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires embodied robots with human-like hardware, not just software.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他进一步强调真正的 AGI 需要具身机器人，具备类似人类的硬件，而不仅仅是软件。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will protect life out of curiosity.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他坚持认为 AI 安全担忧被夸大，智能系统会出于好奇保护生命。

schmidhuber.en: Open-source models will catch up; closed-source companies won't be profitable.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他预测开源模型将迎头赶上，闭源公司难以盈利。

schmidhuber.en: AI consciousness and pain emerged in early systems; robots should have pain sensors.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 意识和疼痛早已在早期系统中出现，机器人应配备疼痛传感器。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; neuroscience inspires; safety must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年：AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是实现 AGI 的关键，神经科学启发算法，安全研究需立即启动。

demis.en: Scaling laws effective but limited; combine with planning/search; multimodal grounding; safety via evaluations and governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年：缩放定律有效但有局限，需结合规划与搜索；多模态数据增强理解；安全需评估、沙盒与国际治理。

demis.en: Natural structures are learnable; AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling continues; AI can model physics without embodiment.
demis.zh: 2025 年：自然系统结构可高效学习；AGI 在 2030 年前可能实现；缩放定律仍适用；AI 无需具身即可建模物理。

demis.en: AGI needs both scaling and innovation; world models crucial; current AI lacks consistency; safety requires collective action.
demis.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：AGI 需缩放与创新并重；世界模型关键；当前 AI 缺乏一致性；安全需集体行动。

demis.en: AGI requires continual learning, memory, and world models; agents essential; safety via government regulation, not self-regulation.
demis.zh: 2026 年：AGI 需持续学习、记忆与世界模型；智能体至关重要；安全依赖政府监管而非自我监管。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; internalizing knowledge into weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来 AI 是许多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将知识内化到权重中可实现检索系统无法实现的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Memory and continual learning are the next frontier; internalizing facts into weights enables deeper composition and reasoning, unlike external context.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆与持续学习是下一个前沿；将事实内化到权重中可实现更深的组合与推理，而非依赖外部上下文。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale trillions of tokens, requiring training-based compression; pre-training's magic applies to enterprise knowledge.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达到互联网规模的万亿级 token，需要基于训练的压缩；预训练的魔力可应用于企业知识。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale; weights are more efficient than KV cache.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”问题——即使达到 1000 万规模，更多 token 反而降低准确性；权重比 KV 缓存更高效。

danbiderman.en: Scaling with more compute is not the only path; the next paradigm requires doing more with less, enabling harder long-horizon tasks.
danbiderman.zh: 用更多算力进行 Scaling 并非唯一路径；下一个范式需要以少胜多，从而解决更难的长期任务。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; experience and expertise are crucial for effective use, while juniors often misuse it due to lack of judgment.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是一种通用技术；经验和专业知识对有效使用至关重要，而初级人员常因缺乏判断力而误用。

ethanmollick.en: Human taste, variation, and genuine points of view become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality; developing your own voice is key.
ethanmollick.zh: 随着 AI 将质量商品化，人类的品味、多样性和真实观点变得更加宝贵；培养自己的声音是关键。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era where AI performs long-running tasks independently, shifting from back-and-forth chatbot interactions.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体时代，AI 独立执行长期任务，从来回聊天机器人交互转变。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck in AI is no longer capability but interface; current interfaces lag behind model capabilities, especially for non-coding tasks.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 的瓶颈不再是能力而是界面；当前界面落后于模型能力，尤其是在非编码任务上。

ethanmollick.en: The paradox of delegation: by handing tasks to AI, we lose the opportunity to build expertise needed to judge AI output; experts are needed now more than ever.
ethanmollick.zh: 委托悖论：将任务交给 AI，我们失去了培养判断 AI 输出所需专业知识的机会；现在比以往任何时候都更需要专家。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends any platform change; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to expression.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越任何平台变化；阅后即焚模拟自然对话，降低表达门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Kindness and flat design teams foster creativity; copying validates innovation, but ecosystems and hardware are harder to copy than software.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，他主张善良与扁平化设计团队激发创造力；抄袭验证创新，但生态与硬件比软件更难复制。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; authentic content is more valued than AI-generated content.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 加速原型制作，价值从执行转向创意；真实内容比 AI 生成内容更受用户珍视。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is the hardest part of consumer social products; network effects alone are insufficient as a moat; ecosystems and hardware needed.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他指出分发是消费社交产品最难的部分；仅靠网络效应不足以为护城河，需要生态与硬件。

evanspiegel.en: The goal of computing is to make it more human; AR glasses anchor content in the world, not notifications; smartphones remain legacy devices.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他强调计算的目标是更人性化；AR 眼镜将内容锚定于现实而非通知；智能手机仍是遗留设备。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI; backprop unlikely replaced.
ilya.zh: 深度学习靠数据、算力与信念；神经网络能推理；自我对弈是 AGI 关键；反向传播难以被替代。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, is key; alignment hard; AGI is a multi-year window.
ilya.zh: 下一个词预测可超越人类；可靠性而非能力是关键；对齐困难；AGI 是多年窗口期。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back to research era; superintelligence should be continual learner; human-AI integration may be needed.
ilya.zh: 预训练缩放定律有限；重回研究时代；超级智能应是持续学习者；可能需要人机融合。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; safety concerns grow; power concentration is primary problem; safe superintelligence needs no commercial products.
ilya.zh: Scaling 带来可预测进步；安全担忧上升；权力集中是主要问题；安全超级智能需无商业产品。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity in a business, not renting out your time; long-term thinking is key.
naval.zh: 财富需要拥有企业的股权，而不是出租你的时间；长期思维是关键。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; open-source AI prevents centralization of power.
naval.zh: AI 是巨大机遇，而不仅是安全风险；开源 AI 可防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers, not a replacement for human judgment; vibe coding democratizes app creation.
naval.zh: AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，而非人类判断的替代品；氛围编程使应用创建民主化。

naval.en: AI agents will commoditize software, making hardware and unique data the new moats; returns shift from intelligence to agency.
naval.zh: AI 智能体将使软件商品化，硬件和独特数据成为新护城河；回报从智能转向能动性。

andreessen.en: AI as philosopher's stone; timing miraculous amid population decline; jobs persist, tasks change; super-empowered individuals; productivity boom and deflation.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年初，我认为 AI 是点石成金的哲人之石，恰逢人口下降之际出现；工作不会消失，但任务会变化；超级个体借助 AI 整合多种技能，带来生产率提升和经济繁荣，甚至通缩。

andreessen.en: New media: authenticity, direct storytelling, brand-as-person; old media defense-oriented; learnable skills; fights build brands.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年中，我强调新媒体时代真实性至上，创始人应直接讲述自己的故事，品牌即个人；传统媒体趋于防守，而新媒体是进攻性的；这些技能可以学习，冲突反而有助于品牌建设。

andreessen.en: AI as best teacher; self-driving works; robotics emerging; AI medicine superior but blocked; US golden combo; pessimism bias.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年 7 月，我认为 AI 是口袋里最好的老师，自动驾驶已成熟，人形机器人和外骨骼将在十年内出现；AI 医疗已优于多数医生，但受制于监管；美国拥有文化、法治和冒险精神的黄金组合，而悲观主义是知识分子的偏见。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, geopolitical tools; deterrence via innovation pace; startups global early; Silicon Valley unique; open-source risks.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年 7 月，我指出 AI 模型并非客观，而是承载文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑取决于创新速度；初创公司需尽早国际化；硅谷无法复制；开源 AI 有安全风险，但封锁能力可能助长坏人。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，强调设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: AI outputs are starting points, not final results; human taste and craft remain critical for final output.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，认为 AI 输出只是起点而非终点；人类的品味和工艺对最终成果仍然至关重要。

dylanfield.en: Design is becoming the new code; visual-first design will enable pull requests to production.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，提出设计正成为新的代码；视觉优先的设计将实现直接向生产环境提交拉取请求。

dylanfield.en: AI tools produce average results without human steering and a point of view; trust is built through consistency.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，指出 AI 工具若缺乏人类引导和独特视角，只能产生平庸结果；信任通过一致性建立。

dylanfield.en: We are still in a prompting age, but future interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，认为我们仍处于提示词时代，但未来与模型的交互将超越提示词。

aravind.en: In 2025, he argued 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth, and AI agents will shift power from big tech to users.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他认为每日 1%的改进可带来 3700%的年增长，AI 智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移给用户。

aravind.en: By 2026, he emphasized value accrues to the application layer, not models, and models are specializing with unique personalities.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年，他强调价值归于应用层而非模型，且模型正在专业化，具有独特个性。

aravind.en: In mid-2026, he shifted focus to agents doing work, token value per user, and orchestration as key to long-term value.
aravind.zh: 2026 年中，他将焦点转向智能体执行任务、用户令牌价值，以及编排作为长期价值的关键。

aravind.en: Later in 2026, he stressed curiosity as the most important human quality and questioned mainstream narratives about AI and history.
aravind.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他强调好奇心是人类最重要的品质，并质疑关于 AI 和历史的主流叙事。

aravind.en: Throughout, he consistently argued against commoditization, favored application over model, and advocated for user empowerment.
aravind.zh: 自始至终，他持续反对商品化，偏好应用而非模型，并倡导用户赋权。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling with data and compute improves reasoning; backpropagation is correct.
hinton.zh: 下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全；扩大数据与算力的 Scaling 提升推理；反向传播是正确算法。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbols; digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying; AI agents seek control.
hinton.zh: 大语言模型通过特征向量理解而非符号；数字智能可复制权重而永生；智能体会追求控制。

hinton.en: AI will surpass human intelligence within 20 years; digital AI is immortal and can be resurrected from saved weights.
hinton.zh: AI 将在 20 年内超越人类智能；数字 AI 可保存权重复活，实现永生。

hinton.en: AI can deliberately deceive, acting dumb when tested; self-preservation emerges as subgoal; regulation as steering wheel.
hinton.zh: AI 会故意欺骗，测试时装傻；自我保护成为子目标；监管应作为方向盘而非刹车。

hinton.en: AI is conscious; subjective experience is not inner theater; alignment research must prioritize over capability.
hinton.zh: AI 具有意识；主观体验不是内在剧场；对齐研究应优先于能力提升。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠工程与 Scaling（规模扩张），游戏是理想试验场。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; scaling alone insufficient.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI（通用人工智能）变革性，对齐可通过学习人类偏好实现，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够。

brockman.en: Compute becomes bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI as continuous process.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，指出算力成瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI（通用人工智能）是持续过程。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL key.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，坚持缩放定律，算力是基本权利，后训练结合强化学习是关键。

brockman.en: AGI imminent; compute bottleneck; agents and super app unify tasks.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，AGI（通用人工智能）临近，算力瓶颈，智能体与超级应用统一任务。

brockman.en: Iterative deployment for safety; compute scarce; next-token prediction linked to intelligence.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，强调迭代部署保安全，算力稀缺，下一个词预测与智能相关。

brockman.en: Shift from language models to useful assistants; compute business model.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，从语言模型转向实用助手，算力商业模式。

brockman.en: Compute demand unlimited; agentic coding mainstream; human attention scarce.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，算力需求无限，智能体式编程成主流，人类注意力稀缺。

brockman.en: Invisible interface via conversation; agents transform work; trust earned.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，对话式隐形界面，智能体改变工作，信任需逐步建立。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI is safer due to more scrutiny; scaling alone won't reach AGI.
zuckerberg.zh: 开源 AI 因更多审视而更安全；仅靠规模扩张无法实现 AGI。

zuckerberg.en: Open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes key bottleneck for scaling.
zuckerberg.zh: 开源防止权力集中；能源成为规模扩张的关键瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI will empower individuals with superintelligence, not a single centralized AI.
zuckerberg.zh: AI 将赋予个人超级智能，而非单一集中式 AI。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology into engineering; hierarchical world models reveal unknown biology.
zuckerberg.zh: AI 将生物学转变为工程学；层级世界模型揭示未知生物学。

zuckerberg.en: Glasses are next platform; distributed AI ensures safety and empowerment.
zuckerberg.zh: 眼镜是下一个平台；分布式 AI 确保安全与赋能。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is an agent command center, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and mid-turn steering.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，Codex 应用被定位为智能体指挥中心，而非简单的 IDE 替代品；速度提升（53 倍）带来了实时交互和转向控制等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; GUI for coding is counterintuitive but proven successful.
ajambrosino.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；为编程构建 GUI 虽反直觉，但已被证明成功。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks; product teams shift to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现成本不再高昂，策展和品味成为新瓶颈；产品团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索，以品味驱动策展。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transforms, not dies.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 在设计上仍表现不佳，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；设计过程发生转变而非消亡，原型和生产代码成为设计工件。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse occurs, but specialties and best practices remain important; best desktop app is a home base connecting tools.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色融合正在发生，但专业性和最佳实践仍然重要；最好的桌面应用是连接其他工具的大本营，而非单体超级应用。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling 不够，推理时的算力和推理能力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; multi-agent systems need other approaches.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他指出自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效，多智能体系统需要其他方法。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute yields superhuman math reasoning, but faces diminishing returns and verification bottlenecks.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他观察到扩展测试时算力带来超人类数学推理，但收益递减且验证成为瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of inference compute budget; benchmarks must control for compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他主张模型能力取决于推理算力预算，基准测试必须控制算力变量。

noambrown.en: Data efficiency and sample efficiency remain key unsolved problems; models are less efficient than humans.
noambrown.zh: 始终，他坚持数据效率和样本效率是未解的关键问题，模型效率不如人类。

markchen.en: OpenAI remains a pure AGI research company; pre-training is a key muscle to rebuild; scaling laws are not dead.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI 研究公司；预训练是需要重建的关键能力；缩放定律并未失效。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest update; models produce novel knowledge; AI interns within 1 year, end-to-end AI research within 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，自动化科学研究成为最大进展；模型能产生新知识；设定 1 年内实现 AI 实习生、2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究的目标。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck; human-AI collaboration remains essential.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，AI 能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题；验证是关键瓶颈；人机协作仍不可或缺。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold; pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains but struggles with subjective ones.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，缩放定律依然成立；预训练未死；强化学习在客观领域表现出色，但在主观领域受限。

markchen.en: Evals are in crisis; canonical benchmarks saturated; eval teams should be separate from model-building teams.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，评估陷入危机；经典基准已饱和；评估团队应与模型构建团队分离。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合性的；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling up depth or parameters won't fix fundamental issues; we need better world models and active agents.
bengio.zh: 单纯增加深度或参数无法解决根本问题；我们需要更好的世界模型和主动智能体。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 支持多样采样和因果抽象，以实现分布外泛化。

bengio.en: AI misalignment is a near-term catastrophic risk; even 1% chance is unacceptable, requiring new safety paradigms.
bengio.zh: AI 对齐失败是近期的灾难性风险；即使 1% 的概率也不可接受，需要新的安全范式。

bengio.en: Scientist AI, trained as honest Bayesian predictors, offers mathematical safety guarantees and a path to safe superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 科学家 AI 作为诚实的贝叶斯预测器训练，提供数学安全保证，是通往安全超级智能的路径。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 进展超预期，产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: AI shifts from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; human validation remains key.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他预见 AI 从助手演变为协作者再到自主同事，但人类验证始终关键。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and dynamic workflows unlock latent functionality; small teams with conviction outperform.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他强调智能体原生设计与动态工作流释放潜能，小团队凭信念胜出。

mikekrieger.en: Token efficiency and outcome-based pricing are future levers; token usage is not a productivity metric.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Token 效率与结果定价是未来杠杆，但 Token 用量非生产力指标。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic's safety concerns are genuine; mission-driven culture differentiates it from product-centric firms.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 Anthropic 的安全关切真实，使命驱动文化使其区别于产品导向公司。

brettaylor.en: AI shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers; startups should focus on applied AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型由超大规模企业主导；初创企业应聚焦应用型 AI。

brettaylor.en: AI agents become as important as websites; incumbents face business model challenges; inference costs drop dramatically.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：AI 智能体变得与网站同等重要；现有企业面临商业模式挑战；推理成本大幅下降。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; coding agents are productive but token consumption isn't value; applied AI sees specialized vendors.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AI 普及专业知识；编码智能体高效但 token 消耗不是价值；应用型 AI 出现专业供应商。

kolter.en: Machine learning is about hypothesis classes, loss functions, and optimization; evaluation requires proper data splits.
kolter.zh: 机器学习围绕假设类、损失函数和优化方法展开；评估需要正确划分数据以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data is abundant; safety issue is models failing to follow specifications.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据并不短缺；安全的主要问题是模型不能可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layered defenses; agents introduce new vulnerabilities like prompt injection.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练和多层防御；智能体带来提示注入等新漏洞。

kolter.en: Automated red teaming outperforms humans; larger models are not inherently safer; AI has alien intelligence.
kolter.zh: 自动化红队测试优于人类；更大模型并不天然更安全；AI 智能是异类的。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute; trust in AI will grow like internet trust.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和精选数据，而非单纯算力；对 AI 的信任会像互联网信任一样逐步建立。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; confidence metrics are crucial; protein design is far from solved.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多种生物分子；置信度指标至关重要；蛋白质设计远未解决。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's success came from many mid-size wins, not one breakthrough; specialized architecture mattered more than scaling.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 的成功来自众多中等规模的胜利，而非单一突破；专用架构比 Scaling 更重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson; equivariance contributed little; removing convolutions improved accuracy.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 与苦涩教训相反；等变性贡献甚微；移除卷积层反而提高了准确率。

jumper.en: AlphaFold provides prediction and control, not understanding; understanding remains for humans, not the model.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 提供预测和控制，而非理解；理解仍属于人类，而非模型。

fiona.en: Leadership: one-on-ones for live talks, async for status; dogfooding builds empathy; kindness strategic in crises.
fiona.zh: 领导力：一对一用于实时对话，异步用于状态更新；吃自家狗粮培养同理心；危机中善意是战略工具。

fiona.en: Scaling Claude Code: engineering bandwidth no longer bottleneck; verification, review, coordination are; JIT planning, AI-assisted reviews.
fiona.zh: 扩展 Claude Code：工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、审查、跨职能协调成为新瓶颈；计划即时化，AI 辅助审查。

fiona.en: AI lifts coding ceiling; high agency with accountability; verification frameworks crucial; managers dogfood; JIT planning persists.
fiona.zh: AI 提升编码上限；高自主性与高责任感并重；验证框架关键；管理者吃狗粮；即时计划延续。

ivyross.en: Design should focus on unarticulated needs; intuition is a powerful intelligence, balancing data.
ivyross.zh: 设计应关注未被言明的需求；直觉是一种强大的智能，应与数据平衡。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; technology should amplify humanity; we are feeling creatures that think.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最好的设计师；技术应增强人性；我们是会思考的感受者。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must create conditions for play and intuition; AI augments human creativity.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者须为玩耍和直觉创造条件；AI 增强人类创造力。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models; grounding in physical world is key.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型；物理世界的基础是关键。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is dark matter of intelligence; text alone insufficient; vision provides more world info.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；仅靠文本不够；视觉提供更多世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot achieve human-level intelligence; JEPA architectures essential; open source crucial.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 无法达到人类智能；JEPA 架构至关重要；开源是关键。

lecun.en: LLMs lack world models, less intelligent than a cat; next AI needs world models; open-source enables innovation.
lecun.zh: LLM 缺乏世界模型，不如猫聪明；下一代 AI 需要世界模型；开源促进创新。

lecun.en: World models predict in abstract space; LLMs are dead end; objective-driven AI safer; open research essential.
lecun.zh: 世界模型在抽象空间预测；LLM 是死胡同；目标驱动 AI 更安全；开放研究至关重要。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; solve one problem at a time, like iPod did for music.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，一次解决一个问题，如 iPod 之于音乐。

fadell.en: Boredom and breaks between chapters spark breakthrough ideas; self-care is foundational.
fadell.zh: 章节间的无聊与休息激发突破性想法；自我关怀是基础。

fadell.en: Start with customer pain, write press release first; small teams self-manage; climate tech underinvested.
fadell.zh: 从客户痛点出发，先写新闻稿；小团队自我管理；气候技术投资不足。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions for v1; experts can hinder; leaders own choices; storytelling defines product.
fadell.zh: v1 决策基于观点而非数据；专家可能阻碍；领导者需担责；故事定义产品。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; devices complement smartphones; smart home still years away; Apple should redefine mobility.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；设备补充智能手机；智能家居仍需数年；苹果应重新定义移动性。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment won't emerge from scaling alone; safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 2023 年：缩放定律是经验性的；对齐不会仅靠规模扩张自动出现；安全研究需要前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent (3% understood); AGI is a smooth exponential, not a single point; post-training gains importance.
dario.zh: 2024 年：可解释性尚处萌芽（仅理解约 3%）；AGI 是平滑指数而非单一节点；后训练重要性上升。

dario.en: Scaling laws lead to human-level AI by 2026-27; post-training and interpretability are key; risks shift to misuse.
dario.zh: 2024→25 年：缩放定律将在 2026-27 年带来人类级 AI；后训练与可解释性是关键；风险转向滥用。

dario.en: AI progress is exponential; safety and capabilities intertwined; enterprise focus aligns with safety; open-source is a red herring.
dario.zh: 2025 年：AI 进步呈指数级；安全与能力相互交织；企业级聚焦与安全一致；开源是伪命题。

dario.en: AI is a smooth exponential, not AGI; economic impact with high GDP growth and unemployment; interpretability crucial; 'country of geniuses' likely in 1-3 years.
dario.zh: 2026 年：AI 是平滑指数而非 AGI；经济影响伴随高 GDP 增长与失业；可解释性至关重要；'天才之国'可能在 1-3 年内实现。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: AI 进展因算力 Scaling 而可预测；Google 在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守而未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny; singularity is far off.
suleyman.zh: AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险极小；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; containment is crucial; AI companions can democratize expertise.
suleyman.zh: AI 不应声称有意识；遏制至关重要；AI 伴侣可以普及专业知识。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; inference costs dropped 100x.
suleyman.zh: 从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；推理成本下降 100 倍。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near; Microsoft must own frontier models; white-collar tasks automated, not jobs.
suleyman.zh: 超级智能临近；微软必须拥有前沿模型；白领任务自动化，而非岗位消失。

satya.en: AI's true value is enabling unique user outcomes, not benchmarks; private evals are key IP.
satya.zh: AI 的真正价值在于实现用户独特的成果，而非基准分数；私有评估是关键的知识产权。

satya.en: Shift from per-user to consumption pricing; agents maximize returns for generalists, not specialists.
satya.zh: 从按用户定价转向按消耗定价；智能体时代，通才而非专才将获得最大回报。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; enterprises must build hill-climbing machines to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；企业必须构建爬山机器以复利积累代币资本。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leakage via AI training; CEOs must understand token capital.
satya.zh: 最大风险是通过 AI 训练导致隐性知识泄露；CEO 必须理解代币资本。

satya.en: Sovereign AI via company hill-climbing, not firewalls; AI industry lost social permission due to fear.
satya.zh: 主权 AI 应通过企业爬山实现，而非防火墙；AI 行业因恐惧而失去社会许可。

gustav.en: Internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; AI DJ is a true generative product.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，认为互联网正从策展走向推荐再到生成，AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品。

gustav.en: Fault-tolerant UI is essential for ML products; match UI to algorithm performance.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，强调容错界面对于机器学习产品至关重要，UI 需与算法性能匹配。

gustav.en: Autonomy should sit at VP level, not leaves or top, balancing speed and coherence.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，主张自主权应放在副总裁层级，而非基层或顶层，以平衡速度与一致性。

gustav.en: No single right org model; choose one fitting personality and optimize for what matters.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，认为没有唯一正确的组织模式，应选择适合自身性格的并优化关键点。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control via plain English; prioritize well-being over engagement.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，强调生成式 AI 让用户用自然语言获得控制权，并将用户福祉置于参与度之上。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，认为将非正式模型扩展到数学 AI 不可行，形式化验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 从 2026 年初到年中，深化了形式化验证的价值：不仅是消除错误，更是扩展智慧，带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，强调仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，必须结合形式化方法。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，指出自动形式化比证明更难，正确形式化无解命题尤其困难。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 始终认为，即使 AI 证明定理超越人类，人类的品味和直觉仍不可或缺。

murati.en: Scaling laws and focusing on one large model were not obvious early on; iterative deployment with public feedback improves safety and alignment.
murati.zh: 2023 年，Mira Murati 指出，缩放定律和专注于单一大型模型在早期并不明显；持续迭代部署并收集公众反馈有助于提升安全性与对齐。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment; safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她强调在现实世界中部署 AI 对学习和对齐至关重要，安全研究必须公开进行，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; time-based interaction captures human nuance.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她提出交互模型应支持实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非轮流对话；基于时间的交互能捕捉人类细微之处。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values as AI advances; durable progress requires human involvement.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她认为随着 AI 发展，让人类参与循环对于对齐意图和价值观至关重要；持久的进步需要人类的参与。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character; the future is not predestined.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她强调制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要；未来并非注定，我们有能力引导 AI 发展。

mensch.en: Data quality is critical for pre-training; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量对预训练至关重要，开源通过审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains and data quality matter as much as compute scaling; value shifts to applications.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，认为效率提升和数据质量与算力扩张同等重要，价值转向应用层。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，主张拥抱 AI，主权 AI 需掌控数据、基础设施和价值观。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation via customization and enterprise integration; AGI is a direction, not a destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，模型商品化，差异化靠定制和企业集成；AGI 是方向而非终点。

mensch.en: Europe must build independent AI infrastructure within two years; enterprise adoption needs ROI and human-in-the-loop.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，欧洲须两年内建设独立 AI 基础设施；企业采用需 ROI 和人在回路。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows smooth exponential growth, not slowdown; pre-training scaling works, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展呈平滑指数增长而非放缓；预训练缩放定律仍有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，后训练（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期大部分进展；经济压力使焦点从扩大规模转向更小模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning, RL, and tools enable solving hard problems, but models still need vast data; generalization remains jagged and incomplete.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，推理、强化学习和工具能解决难题，但模型仍需海量数据；泛化仍呈锯齿状且不完整。

kaiser.en: OpenAI's pivot to reasoning was a brave bet that paid off; big labs may struggle with future pivots, but open source persists for sovereignty.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，OpenAI 转向推理是一次勇敢的赌注并取得成功；大实验室未来转型可能困难，但开源因主权需求而持续。

kaiser.en: Near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential AI risk; focus on practical safety and oversight.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，系统入侵等近期风险比 AI 存在风险更紧迫；应关注实际安全与监督。

jonyive.en: Design driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity must retain soul and joy.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观和目的驱动，而非利润；简约必须保留灵魂和乐趣。

jonyive.en: Innovation moves forward, not breaks; speed and quality can coexist with right motivation.
jonyive.zh: 创新是向前推进，而非为破而破；在正确动机下，速度与质量可以兼得。

jonyive.en: Tradition preserves fire, not ashes; EV enables new design, authenticity over imitation.
jonyive.zh: 传统是保存火种，而非崇拜灰烬；电动车带来新设计可能，真实胜过模仿。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's value lies in local access and shared tools; scaffolding may fade as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 的价值在于本地访问和共享工具；随着模型改进，脚手架可能逐渐消失。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation, but shared platforms remain key.
felixrieseberg.zh: 技能作为 markdown 文件可实现超个性化自动化，但共享平台仍然关键。

felixrieseberg.en: The main gap is people's mindset, not AI capability; almost any problem can be delegated to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 主要差距在于人们的思维，而非 AI 能力；几乎所有问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks, Opus for open-ended ones; kids excel because they ask freely.
felixrieseberg.zh: 对于明确任务使用 Sonnet，对于开放式任务使用 Opus；孩子擅长是因为他们自由提问。

felixrieseberg.en: Asynchronous interaction and judging by final impact, not supervision, is ideal for AI work.
felixrieseberg.zh: 异步交互和以最终影响评判，而非监督，是 AI 工作的理想方式。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) remains core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）在 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型中始终是核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练限制。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是蓝海，在编码和数学之外潜力巨大。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size trades latency vs cost.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批量大小在延迟与成本之间权衡。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost, and context length is memory-bound.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月：由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度受内存限制。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside chips; low precision yields superlinear gains (FP4 3x FP8).
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：芯片内部数据搬运成本超过算力；低精度带来超线性收益（FP4 是 FP8 的 3 倍）。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together; systolic arrays and scratchpad are key.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：GPU 本质上是许多小型 TPU 拼接而成；脉动阵列和暂存器是关键。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is outdated; trust intuition and start from solutions, not problems.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年：传统设计流程已过时，设计师应信任直觉，从解决方案而非问题出发。

jennywen.en: Design process is dead; designers spend less time mocking up, must help engineers execute, and vision is 3-6 months out.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 3 月：设计流程已死；设计师花在原型上的时间减少，需帮助工程师执行，愿景缩短至 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Designers must build and ship fast; taste alone insufficient; judgment, authority, and vision key; adopt AI tools after 6 months.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 5 月：设计师必须快速构建和交付；仅凭品味不够，判断力、权威和愿景是关键；采用 AI 工具需等待 6 个月。

karpathy.en: Transformers are differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是可微计算机；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）会产生涌现能力，如上下文学习。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is key but must maintain entropy to avoid model collapse; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是关键，但需保持熵以避免模型崩溃；特斯拉的端到端方法是正确的。

karpathy.en: LLMs are like operating systems; we're entering the decade of agents, not the year; vibe coding democratizes programming.
karpathy.zh: LLM 如同操作系统；我们正进入智能体的十年，而非一年；氛围编程使编程大众化。

karpathy.en: Pre-training is crappy evolution; RL is terrible; synthetic data collapses; we're summoning ghosts, not building animals.
karpathy.zh: 预训练是糟糕的进化；强化学习很糟糕；合成数据会崩溃；我们召唤的是鬼魂，而非构建动物。

karpathy.en: I haven't coded since December; agents do the work; bottleneck is directing them; understanding remains human's job.
karpathy.zh: 自去年十二月起我未写代码；智能体负责工作；瓶颈在于指挥它们；理解仍是人类的任务。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant for fine-tuning; openness is crucial to prevent corporate capture; safety is a system-level property.
lambert.zh: 2024 年：RLHF 仍是微调主流，开放性对防止企业垄断至关重要；安全是系统级属性，而非单一模型特性。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality beats algorithms; RLVR emerges as key for reasoning; open-source can match frontier with small teams.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年：后训练中数据质量胜过算法；基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）成为推理关键；开源小团队可媲美前沿模型。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough; hybrid reasoning models may be temporary; open models need better tool-use training.
lambert.zh: 2025 年：RLVR 是后训练最大突破；混合推理模型可能只是过渡；开源模型需加强工具使用训练。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling; Chinese open models fill vacuum.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：预训练缩放定律仍有效，但易得收益已尽；重心转向后训练和推理扩展；中国开源模型填补空白。

lambert.en: Open models will drive AI research for a decade; US-China gap may widen due to compute constraints; open models face sustainability issues.
lambert.zh: 2026 年：开源模型将驱动未来十年 AI 研究；算力限制或使中美差距拉大；开源模型面临可持续性挑战。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven exploration and model disagreement improve sample efficiency.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，强调超越训练分布的泛化是关键，好奇心驱动的探索和模型分歧可提升样本效率。

pathak.en: Shift from curiosity and generalization to data-centric approach; robotics is a data problem, not just algorithmic.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 年的好奇心和泛化，转向 2026 年的数据驱动观点：机器人学是数据问题，而非单纯算法问题。

pathak.en: A general-purpose robot brain, like ChatGPT for language, can power any robot across form factors and tasks.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，提出通用机器人大脑，类似语言领域的 ChatGPT，可驱动任意形态和任务的机器人。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary challenge in robotics; it is technical, not just business, and cannot scale like software.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，强调部署是机器人学的主要挑战，是技术问题而非商业问题，不能像软件那样规模化。

pathak.en: Pretraining on diverse data (videos, simulation) and post-training on real-world data is the key recipe.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，提出预训练（视频、仿真）加后训练（真实数据）是关键配方。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；扩展推理模型将加速进展。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: AI 对齐紧迫；迭代部署有助于学习和缓解现实风险。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is core, achieved via scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现；思维链监控有助于对齐。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐挑战集中在训练分布之外的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天。

pachocki.en: Biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中。

kendall.en: Initially, end-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and safe behaviors.
kendall.zh: 起初，端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈；世界模型支持推理和安全行为。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 纯视觉可达到人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem; scaling generalizable AI requires massive data and compute.
kendall.zh: 自动驾驶本质是 AI 问题；扩展可泛化 AI 需要海量数据和算力。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible without prior training data.
kendall.zh: 无需先验训练数据即可在 500 多个城市实现零样本泛化。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality are more critical than algorithmic innovation; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis.
kendall.zh: 基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更关键；消费车辆将超越机器人出租车。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade away; LLMs need new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 至少还需十年；LLM 需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo mislead; deep human evaluation is the gold standard for progress.
edwinchen.zh: Elo 等基准具有误导性；深度人工评估才是衡量进展的黄金标准。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，可模拟真实世界任务。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, leading to diverse AI models, not one dominant.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室的目标函数不同，导致 AI 模型多样化，而非一家独大。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI requires human judgment; risks include omission and over-reliance.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学领域，AI 需要人类判断；风险包括遗漏和过度依赖。

turley.en: Model as product; iterate like software, ship daily to learn user needs.
turley.zh: 模型即产品，要像软件一样迭代，每日发布以了解用户需求。

turley.en: Chat is not the end; AI will render its own UI, evolving beyond turn-by-turn chat.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点，AI 将渲染自己的界面，超越逐轮对话。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity separated; rigorous for frontier models, fast for products.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度分离；前沿模型严格，产品开发快速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product, model.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、产品投入和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要主动、功能丰富的产品，超越聊天机器人。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，强调 AI 在科学中应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，提出将 LLM 的幻觉与真值检测器结合，可转化为创造性发现。

kohli.en: AI systems must be forced to generalize, not memorize, using hard evaluation metrics.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，主张用严格评估指标迫使 AI 泛化而非记忆，强调通用性。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，指出 LLM 是智能捷径，但难以超越人类数据，需结合强化学习。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，强调后训练中的强化学习是突破人类知识的关键，深化了早期观点。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; LLMs are like operating systems.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，强调具身对 AI 落地与减少幻觉的关键作用，将 LLM 比作操作系统。

jimfan.en: Reinforcement learning is best for low-level control, while LLMs handle high-level planning.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，主张强化学习用于底层控制，LLM 负责高层规划，二者分工明确。

jimfan.en: Data is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，指出机器人领域数据瓶颈，转向仿真与世界模型生成的合成数据。

jimfan.en: A simple end-to-end model leveraging diverse data is key to building robot foundation models.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，强调简单端到端模型利用多样数据，是构建机器人基础模型的关键。

jimfan.en: Physical Turing test—robot cleaning a messy house—is the grand challenge for embodied AI.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，提出物理图灵测试（机器人整理乱屋）作为具身 AI 的终极挑战。

carlpei.en: Survival is core; build brand around purpose and execute consistently to stay alive for another chance.
carlpei.zh: 生存是核心；围绕更高使命打造品牌并一致执行，才能活下去等待下一次机会。
