carlpei.en: AI will shift phones from app-based to intent-based, with agents acting as digital twins; hardware becomes secondary.
carlpei.zh: AI 将把手机从基于应用转向基于意图，智能体充当数字孪生；硬件退居其次。

carlpei.en: AI models commoditize; open-source matches commercial, so focus on applied AI and user experience, not hype.
carlpei.zh: AI 模型商品化，开源追平商用；应聚焦应用型 AI 和用户体验，而非炒作。

carlpei.en: Design and marketing arbitrage differentiate mature categories; content creation gives outsized leverage for challengers.
carlpei.zh: 设计和营销套利在成熟品类中实现差异化；内容创作为挑战者带来超比例杠杆。

carlpei.en: Smartphones won't be replaced by glasses; only brain-computer interfaces could kill them; apps will disappear.
carlpei.zh: 手机不会被眼镜取代，只有脑机接口可能终结它；应用将消失。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，认为 AI 应作为增强人类能力的工具，从视频学习和通用智能体是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的可行路径。

nando.en: Emphasis shifted from model scale to AI safety and responsible deployment as the biggest challenges.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年到 2026 年，关注点从模型规模转向 AI 安全与负责任部署，视其为最大挑战。

nando.en: Africa can leapfrog legacy issues; local language models and human skills are key to AI progress there.
nando.zh: 2026 年，认为非洲可跨越遗留问题，本地语言模型和人类技能是 AI 发展的关键。

nando.en: Consistently advocates for diversity, inclusion, and embracing failure in AI research.
nando.zh: 始终倡导 AI 研究中的多样性与包容性，并鼓励拥抱失败。

nando.en: From universal algorithms to open safety problems; collaboration among labs remains informal and vital.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年到 2026 年，从通用算法转向开放的安全问题，实验室间非正式合作依然重要。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence dramatically.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文窗口被低估了；上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能大幅提升模型智能。

sholto.en: RL on language models has no ceiling; pre-training plus RL is likely sufficient for AGI by 2027-2028.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调语言模型上的强化学习没有上限；预训练加强化学习可能足以在 2027-2028 年实现 AGI。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning is a new scaling axis; coding is the leading indicator for AI progress.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我提出强化学习是新的扩展轴；编码是 AI 进步的主要指标。

sholto.en: Despite plateau claims, AI progress accelerates; Transformers are sufficient for AGI, no new architecture needed.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我反驳平台期论，认为 AI 进展加速；Transformer 足以实现 AGI，无需新架构。

sholto.en: Capability overhang dominates; managing agent teams and compute supply are key; world models not critical path.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为能力过剩是主导；管理智能体团队和算力供应是关键；世界模型不在关键路径上。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can match larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；通过更好的数据和算法，较小的模型也能媲美较大的模型。

yejin.en: Post-training with RLHF is crucial for safe responses, but data is proprietary; open alternatives needed.
yejin.zh: 2023 年至 2025 年间，我强调后训练中的 RLHF（基于人类反馈的强化学习）对安全响应至关重要，但数据专有，需探索开放替代方案。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我指出数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是内插人类知识，而非超越。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning can be used during pre-training to improve reasoning, despite compute costs.
yejin.zh: 2025 年至 2026 年间，我提出在预训练阶段使用强化学习可提升推理能力，尽管算力成本高。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; small models with diverse synthetic data can outperform frontier models.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我主张多元对齐以尊重人类价值观多样性；通过多样化合成数据，小模型可超越前沿模型。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，强调设计师应通过写代码建立同理心并加速交付；优先速度与熟悉感，而非追求完美。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should focus on recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines are dynamic platforms.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，认为初创品牌策略应聚焦招聘与差异化；品牌指南是动态平台，而非静态规则。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，将设计提升为战略武器，创始人需阐明设计如何助力公司取胜。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, not clones; give designers ownership and autonomy to grow.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张招聘多元原型而非克隆；赋予设计师所有权与自主权以促进成长。

henrymodisett.en: Brand narrative attracts talent; invest early in brand to stand out and signal quality.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，强调品牌叙事吸引人才；早期投资品牌以脱颖而出并传递品质信号。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; AI is a creative partner.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈，通过引导工程师和统一问题来协作；AI 是创意伙伴。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt, fluctuating and paid off iteratively; rapid scrappy experimentation maximizes learning.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务，波动且需迭代偿还；快速粗糙的实验能最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: Future design tools are interoperable with code as source of truth; legacy tools from the 90s are outdated.
nadchishtie.zh: 未来设计工具应互操作，以代码为源；90 年代的旧工具已过时。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution with AI are most valuable; small teams beat cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 掌握端到端执行并善用 AI 的通才最有价值；小团队优于跨职能大组。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should show craft and intentionality, not process; side projects and paid tests reveal true skill.
nadchishtie.zh: 作品集应展示工艺与意图，而非流程；副项目和付费测试更能体现真实能力。

truell.en: Scaling laws promise predictable AI progress, but test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as the next major driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年，认为缩放定律带来可预测的 AI 进步，但测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展，成为下一个主要驱动力。

truell.en: Natural language won't be the primary programming method; examples and direct manipulation are often better for intent specification.
truell.zh: 2024 年，主张自然语言不会成为主要编程方式，示例和直接操作往往更能表达意图。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central, evolving into higher-level intent specification.
truell.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，从认为智能体有前景但尚不实用，转向强调人类与 AI 的迭代协作，并发展为更高层次的意图指定。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality; every magic moment in Cursor now involves a custom model, not just frontier models.
truell.zh: 2025 年，强调定制模型对产品质量至关重要，Cursor 中的每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型，而非仅依赖前沿模型。

truell.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and take decades; taste and logic design skills become more valuable than carefulness.
truell.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 变革比互联网影响更大且持续数十年，品味和逻辑设计技能将比细心更有价值。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial; empirical research under-explored. PhD in ML is best path; talent gap exceeds funding gap.
leike.zh: 2018 年，强调 AI 安全至关重要，实证研究尚待开发；机器学习博士是成为安全研究员的最佳路径，人才缺口大于资金缺口。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability. Automated alignment research can bootstrap progress.
leike.zh: 2023 年，认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督和可解释性；自动化对齐研究可迭代推进进展。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training insufficient for AGI alignment. External oversight and third-party testing needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年，指出 OpenAI 安全文化退化，后训练不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐；需要外部监管和第三方测试。

shazeer.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction are AI-complete; scaling with compute and data improves intelligence, but internal workings remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为基于下一个词预测训练的大语言模型是 AI 完备的；扩大算力和数据能提升智能，但模型内部机制仍像炼金术一样不可知。

shazeer.en: Scaling inference-time compute and longer context windows are key near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures enable efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他强调推理时算力扩展和更长上下文窗口是近期关键机会；模块化稀疏架构（如专家混合）可实现高效扩展。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not just passive data; continual learning with modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他主张模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非仅被动观察数据；模块化组件的持续学习可取代整体重训。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and RL are crucial for AGI.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为测试时算力扩展推动进步，但仅靠它无法实现 AGI；智能体能力和强化学习对 AGI 至关重要。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped; economic impact far beyond trillion-dollar products. Coding is underhyped; enables self-acceleration of AI.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI 被低估，经济影响远超万亿美元产品；编程也被低估，它能实现 AI 的自我加速。

abbeel.en: In 2018, Abbeel saw RL plus simulation as key for robotics, while noting imitation learning's high signal-to-noise ratio and the need for hierarchical reasoning.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，Abbeel 认为强化学习与仿真结合是机器人学的关键，同时指出模仿学习的高信噪比和层次推理的必要性。

abbeel.en: By 2021, he emphasized unsupervised learning to boost sample efficiency, and warned against hard-coding priors, favoring data augmentation instead.
abbeel.zh: 到 2021 年，他强调用无监督学习提升样本效率，并警告不要硬编码先验知识，而应偏向数据增强。

abbeel.en: He also saw pre-trained language models as transferable to non-language tasks, a shift from his earlier focus on robotics-specific learning.
abbeel.zh: 他还认为预训练语言模型可迁移到非语言任务，这与他早期专注于机器人特定学习有所不同。

abbeel.en: Throughout, he consistently valued self-play and RL for skill acquisition, and believed in the generality of learning methods across domains.
abbeel.zh: 自始至终，他重视自博弈和强化学习在技能获取中的作用，并相信学习方法跨领域的通用性。

abbeel.en: His stance on hard-coding evolved: from using priors for data generation in 2018 to explicitly rejecting hard-coded priors by 2021.
abbeel.zh: 他对硬编码的态度有所演变：从 2018 年利用先验进行数据生成，到 2021 年明确拒绝硬编码先验。
